author: Embers83
quote: The game is a total technical disaster. The frame rates in this game drop to 19 frames per sec, the stuttering from the lack of frames when driving in crowded areas gave me literal nausea, and the bugs, glitches which were also included with the game are unacceptable. While driving a car my vehicle got launched straight into the air because there are some sort of invisible game artifacts within the game world which when triggered cause your vehicle to launch into the sky at a 45 degree angle. It must be a piece of code which was overlooked while developing this game, but it cheapens the entire experience and especially for a game which can cost upward of $400 is just simply unacceptable. In my opinion there are other games which simply have better gameplay, more interesting game worlds, and have more to offer than just the graphical fidelity of GTA 6. This game isn't all that immersive either strictly because of the graphics because the world feels soulless, empty, and boring even when you take into account that there are plenty of NPCs walking around the map. The game feels shallow and the entire experience proves that graphics and hype aren't everything in video games.
